name: Elections
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign initiator in the election of believers, choosing us before the foundation of the world to live holy lives in love. Christ affirms that believers do not come to Him by their own choosing, but because the Father has given them to Him, and He will never reject those who come. This divine selection is purposeful, calling believers to bear lasting fruit and to receive answered prayer. Ultimately, those ordained to eternal life respond in faith, glorifying God's word with joy.
